Study & Careers

Jiayu Chen · Mathematics

Home · Resources

A source-linked directory of mathematics study and research opportunities, with research-oriented masters at its centre. Pure mathematics is the primary focus; applied mathematics is labelled separately.

All programmes are shown initially. Use destination, country / territory, degree and application-time filters together. Unknown windows remain visible unless you request dated results. Reviewed dates are not a live portal check; an institution may amend a notice or close early. Funding and examination deadlines are separate, and awards are never automatic.

Preparation & application guides · Find researchers / potential supervisors · Country coverage & remaining gaps · Fee-status rules & limits

Your background — optional, local only

No location detection, account, upload or automatic saving. You may skip every field. A student visa does not automatically grant local tuition. This tool explains known rules; it does not predict admission, rank applicants or certify eligibility.

Dutch statutory-fee reference — additional optional conditions

The published amount below is 2026–27 only. Specific permit codes and exceptions are not automatically assessed.

Optional — no personal background is required.

Application time

Dates are reviewed records, not a live portal check. Unknown dates remain in All. Date-only deadlines retain their uncertainty.

The end date must not precede the start date.

International applicants / process
Check whether your residence and qualifications require Mon Master, Études en France or the university’s M2 application portal. M1 and M2 have different entry requirements; do not submit through an assumed universal route.
Tuition
Not verified for the next intake or your citizenship/residence category. Request the amount, currency, charging period and mandatory additional fees before accepting an offer.

No funding guarantee is made. Check scholarship eligibility, separate application dates, duration, renewal conditions and whether tuition and living costs are covered.
